dun_vanda_guide.text: In the Scottish Design Galleries there's Mackintosh's Oak Room, a tearoom from Miss Cranston's in Glasgow, taken down in the 1970s, kept in pieces for fifty years, and put back together here.
And there's everything from Dundee-made comics and video games to tweed, tartan and Scottish-made jumpers. Design is everywhere. Even in the tea towels. Especially in the tea towels.
